resources.string: Leave empty if Telegram Desktop has no local passcode. This is not your Telegram two-step verification password.
Only import your own session. This will reuse its authorization. Do not run clients with the same authorization at the same time: Telegram may revoke it.

The exported file grants full access to your account without a login code or two-step verification password. Save it only to a location you trust. Revoke this device in Telegram if the file is exposed.
Invalid session. Check the format, 256-byte auth key and DC ID (1–5). Production user accounts only.
Cannot read the document. Select a standalone Telethon or Pyrogram .session database, closed cleanly by its client.
Cannot read tdata. Check the local passcode and ZIP contents (key_data and account authorization files). Remove cache files if the archive exceeds 64 MB unpacked.
Session verification failed or timed out. Check your connection, DC ID and whether the authorization is still valid.
This account or authorization is already added.
Could not export the session. Check the destination and available space. The destination may contain an incomplete file.
